text: Default attack is a strike without charging or wrestling.
translation: 預設攻擊為一般打擊，不使用衝撞或摔角。

text: Default attack is a charging strike.
Default attack is a wrestling move.
Choose default attack according to opponent.
translation: 依對手選擇預設攻擊方式。

text: Freely move between tiles when dodging if necessary
translation: 閃避時可視需要自由移動到其他地格

text: Do not move from current tile when dodging even if it means being struck.
translation: 閃避時留在目前地格，即使因此被擊中。

text: Dodge away from charging opponents to avoid being knocked over.
translation: 閃開衝撞而來的對手，以免被撞倒。

text: Attempt to stop charging opponents, standing your ground.
translation: 堅守原地，嘗試阻止衝撞而來的對手。

text: Handle charging attacks according to the opponent.
translation: 依對手決定如何應對衝撞攻擊。

text: Strike somebody adjacent with a melee attack.  Also allows available parry, block, and dodge moves.
translation: 以近戰攻擊打擊鄰近目標，也可使用目前可用的招架、格擋與閃避動作。

text: All of your progress since the last save will be lost.
translation: 上次儲存之後的所有進度都將遺失。

text: This is the inventory menu.[B]Here you can interact with the objects you are carrying.  Items can be dropped, worn, eaten, thrown, named, etc.  The icon tooltips describe your options for each item.  [B]Inventory items are all worn, held, in containers, or otherwise related to specific body parts.  There is no abstract inventory space.  [B]If you are carrying too much, you'll see an encumbrance indicator above the inventory button.  Encumbrance can cause you to move very slowly and should be avoided if possible.
translation: 這是物品欄選單。[B]你可以在這裡操作隨身攜帶的物品，例如丟棄、穿戴、食用、投擲或命名。各個圖示的提示會說明該物品可用的操作。[B]物品都實際穿戴在身上、拿在手中、放在容器裡，或與特定身體部位有關；遊戲沒有抽象的物品欄空間。[B]如果攜帶過多物品，物品欄按鈕上方會顯示負重提示。負重可能使你的移動速度非常緩慢，應盡量避免。

text: This is the attack menu.  Here you can strike creatures with an item or body part, or you can initiate a dodge or parry movement.  [B]Attacks target specific body parts and have various modifiers.  You will select these in the subsequent menus.  There is a random element to outcomes and some body parts will be easier or harder to hit from moment to moment.  However, skill is the most important determiner of hits versus misses.  [B]Once a strike hits, the materials and velocity are used to determine the damage.  Skill and item quality can help with this, but sometimes it's just not possible to damage a target material with a weaker material.  For this reason, it's important to obtain better equipment when you can.
translation: 這是攻擊選單。你可以用物品或身體部位打擊生物，也可以進行閃避或招架。[B]攻擊會瞄準特定的身體部位，並有多種修正選項；你會在接下來的選單中選擇它們。結果包含隨機因素，而且各部位在不同時刻的命中難度會改變。不過，技能仍是決定命中與否最重要的因素。[B]打擊命中後，傷害由材質與速度決定。技能和物品品質有助於造成傷害，但較弱的材質有時無法傷到目標材質。因此，有機會時取得更好的裝備很重要。

text: The view is dark underground.  You can recenter on yourself with the [KEY:418] hotkey or by clicking the recenter button.
translation: 地下的視野昏暗。按下 [KEY:418] 快捷鍵或點擊重新置中按鈕，即可將視角移回自己身上。

text: You can zoom in and out of the play area using [KEY:9][KEY:10], [C:2:0:1]Ctrl+mouse wheel[C:7:0:0], or the indicated buttons.
translation: 可按 [KEY:9][KEY:10]，或[C:2:0:1]按住控制鍵並滾動滑鼠滾輪[C:7:0:0]，也可點擊指示的按鈕，以放大或縮小遊戲畫面。

text: To change the camera's elevation, [C:2:0:1]roll the mouse wheel[C:7:0:0].
translation: 若要改變視角的高度層，請[C:2:0:1]滾動滑鼠滾輪[C:7:0:0]。

text: When your view is in the air above other tiles, you can usually see them below.  If you are indoors or in a cavern, your view might be blocked by the ceiling.
translation: 當視角位於其他地格上方的空中時，通常能看到下層的地格。若位於室內或洞穴中，天花板可能會遮住視線。

text: Retire at this location (or rest a while)

You've finally got your equipment together, such as it is.  Now it's time for action and adventure!  In the rush of excitement, you've forgotten where you were going to go.  Perhaps some of your friends here can remind you.[B]Before you begin your travels, we'll familiarize you with the basic controls.
translation: 你總算湊齊了裝備，雖然不怎麼樣。現在是展開行動與冒險的時候了！興奮之餘，你卻忘了原本打算去哪裡。或許這裡的朋友能提醒你。[B]在踏上旅途之前，我們會先帶你熟悉基本操作。

text: Your view is focused on one elevation at a time.  To move the camera around, hold the middle mouse button and drag the view.
translation: 畫面每次只顯示一個高度層。按住滑鼠中鍵並拖曳，即可移動視角。

text: Every creature in adventure mode moves simultaneously.  Once you initiate movement, play will advance until you can move again.  The duration of movement depends on gait, injuries, etc.
translation: 冒險模式中的所有生物都會同時行動。你開始移動後，遊戲時間會推進，直到你能再次行動。移動所需時間取決於步態、傷勢等因素。

text: You can click the indicated button or press [KEY:331] to view your character's status.  This can be used to view your injuries, skills and needs.
translation: 點擊指示的按鈕或按下 [KEY:331]，即可查看角色狀態，包括傷勢、技能與需求。

text: There's a lot more to learn![B]As you enter new menus, there will be information and tips.[B]The [C:5:0:1]Help[C:7:0:0] button at the top of the screen contains more guides. Click it now, and this tutorial will be concluded.
translation: 還有很多東西等著你學習！[B]開啟新的選單時，會顯示相關資訊與提示。[B]畫面上方的[C:5:0:1]說明[C:7:0:0]按鈕提供更多指南。現在點擊它，即可完成本教學。

text: Click a creature to start a new conversation
translation: 點擊生物以開始新的對話

text: This is the conversation menu.[B]Conversations occur over time, like movements and attacks.  When speaking to somebody, you'll choose what to say, and then time will pass while you are speaking and waiting for a reply.  [B]There are many conversation options.  Important ones to note at first are inquiring about troubles, which might set you on the road to adventure, asking for duties from your leader if you have one, and the ability to trade in shops.  You can also ask anybody to join you, but many people will be shy of danger.
translation: 這是對話選單。[B]如同移動與攻擊，對話也需要時間。與人交談時，先選擇要說的話；在你說話及等待回覆時，時間都會推進。[B]對話選項很多。初期值得留意的選項包括：打聽麻煩，這可能引領你展開冒險；向領主請求任務（如果你有所屬領主）；以及在商店交易。你也可以邀請任何人加入隊伍，但許多人會畏懼危險。

text: Bring up specific incident or rumor (new menu)
translation: 提起特定事件或傳聞（開啟選單）

text: Exchange, give, take or show personal items
translation: 交換、贈送、索取或展示個人物品

text: Ask favor, place request, make demand or issue order (new menu)
translation: 請人幫忙、提出請求或要求、下達命令（開啟選單）

text: Ask listener to join you (new menu)
translation: 邀請對方加入隊伍（開啟選單）

text: Claim this site for yourself (group naming menu)
translation: 宣稱擁有此地（開啟團體命名選單）

text: Ask about this site's neighbors and trade partners
translation: 詢問此地的鄰近聚落與貿易夥伴
表達你的情緒（開啟選單）
陳述你的價值觀（開啟選單）

text: Accuse listener of being a night creature
Brag about your past violent acts
translation: 吹噓你過去的暴力事蹟

text: This is common knowledge where you are from.
translation: 這在你的家鄉是人盡皆知的事。

text: You have known this person since his birth.
translation: 自他出生起，你就認識他了。

text: You have known this person since her birth.
translation: 自她出生起，你就認識她了。

text: You have encountered these creatures in the past but not recently.
translation: 你以前曾遇過這些生物，但最近沒有。

text: You have recently encountered one of these creatures.
translation: 你最近曾遇過這類生物。

text: This is your adventurer's log.  It functions as an encyclopedia of your known world, and also keeps track of important agreements, such as quests.  In the beginning, you'll probably find it populated with a variety of rumors and knowledge known to everybody from your home.  This could include some opportunities for adventure.
translation: 這是你的冒險者日誌。它是你已知世界的百科全書，也記錄任務等重要約定。起初，日誌中可能已經收錄家鄉人人皆知的各種傳聞與知識，其中或許就有冒險的契機。

text: What do you want to aim for?
Quick attack: faster to strike and recover, but not powerful
translation: 快速攻擊：出手與恢復較快，但威力較弱

text: Heavy attack: slower to strike and recover, but hits harder
translation: 重擊：出手與恢復較慢，但威力較強

text: Wild attack: fast strike, slow recovery, hard but unbalancing/inaccurate
translation: 狂猛攻擊：出手快、恢復慢，力道強但容易失衡且不準確

text: Precise attack: very slow to strike, improved accuracy
translation: 精準攻擊：出手非常慢，但命中率較高

text: Charge attack: move toward your opponent
Multi-attack: choose another simultaneous action afterward
translation: 多重攻擊：接著再選擇另一個同時執行的動作
